name: Bangladesh

findings.summary: BTCL signed an equipment-supply contract with Huawei for its 5G Readiness Project after Huawei bid lowest (Tk 3.26bn) against ZTE and Nokia in a tender opened August 2022; press reported procedural irregularities in the evaluation.
findings.analyst_inference: Contract value is in taka (Tk 3.26bn bid); not converted to USD because no source-date exchange rate was retrieved. Both sources are general press (S3), so not corroborated under the S1/S2 rule. BTCL reportedly posted contract documents online; not retrieved.

findings.local_actor: BTCL; Anti-Corruption Commission; Posts and Telecom Division
findings.reversal_of: BGD-001 BTCL 5G Readiness Project equipment contract with Huawei
findings.summary: By August 2025 the BTCL 5G Readiness Project had stalled: the ACC sought suspension citing irregularities and a Tk 3bn letter of credit was cancelled, though a court later let it proceed.
findings.analyst_inference: Coded as a pause, not a cancellation: the article reports no formal termination, and the court allowed the project to proceed. The article does not name Huawei; linkage to BGD-001 is by project name. An interim-government fact-finding report found procurement rules were followed, contested by board members.

findings.summary: State operator Teletalk signed an agreement with Huawei for its initial 5G network; Huawei said it would supply over 65% of initial 5G sites, with launch planned for 12 December 2021.

sources.publisher: Prothom Alo (relaying a Huawei press release)

findings.analyst_inference: Tiered S4 because the article reproduces a Huawei press release. The vendor for the remaining ~35% of sites is not named. Contract value not disclosed.

findings.summary: Grameenphone, the largest operator, made Huawei its exclusive vendor under a three-year agreement to expand radio and core network with SingleRAN base stations nationwide.
findings.analyst_inference: Historical (2010) and single-source; current RAN/core vendor mix at Grameenphone, including for its 2025 5G launch, was not established in this pass.

findings.summary: BTRC issued Starlink's local entity a 10-year non-geostationary satellite operator licence and a radio-equipment licence, authorising commercial satellite internet service in Bangladesh.
findings.analyst_inference: Two independent S3 sources agree, but neither is S1/S2, so not corroborated under the rule. Licence issued under the post-2024 interim government; commercial launch reported later (not fetched).

findings.summary: Cabinet purchase committee cleared ZTE to build the Tier IV National Data Centre at Kaliakair Hi-Tech Park, financed by China Exim Bank; later reporting said ZTE's work was about 70% complete with Uptime Institute certification.
findings.analyst_inference: Owner/operator is the Bangladesh state; coded prc because ZTE built and equipped the facility and is the likely maintenance/update dependency. DCD gave US$155.4M (Tk 12bn); Daily Star gave Tk 1,516 crore total cost — figures differ, so values left null. Current operational status not verified (tier 4, not 5).

findings.local_actor: Bangladesh Computer Council; Sylhet Metropolitan Police
findings.summary: Huawei supplied the 'Digital Sylhet City' system: about 110 AI cameras with face and number-plate recognition feeding a police control room, plus public Wi-Fi; pilot systems were inaugurated in late July 2019.
findings.analyst_inference: Coded tier 2 as a city-scale pilot. Contract instrument and value not stated. Whether the system was expanded to other cities, or to Dhaka's planned CCTV programmes, is unknown.

findings.summary: A Bangladeshi ministerial delegation met Google for Education in Mountain View to explore cooperation including AI-supported teacher training and Bangla-language AI; both sides expressed interest in forming working groups, with no agreement signed.
findings.analyst_inference: Exploratory discussion only, coded tier 1 as a statement of intent; no model adoption or deployment evidenced.

silicon.null_reason: no public accelerator purchases, deployments or export-licence decisions surfaced in data-centre and AI searches

power.null_reason: no AI- or data-centre-specific power evidence surfaced; search budget spent on other layers

research_gaps: Current RAN and core vendors for Grameenphone, Robi and Banglalink, especially for their 2025 5G launches (Huawei vs Ericsson/Nokia/ZTE shares).
Final status of the BTCL-Huawei 5G Readiness Project after the ACC review and court ruling; was the contract terminated, re-tendered or resumed?
Is the Kaliakair Tier IV National Data Centre operational at scale, and who holds its maintenance/support contract? Reconcile the US$155.4M vs Tk 1,516 crore cost figures.
Teletalk 5G: vendor for the non-Huawei share of sites and contract value.
Any safe-city or CCTV programme in Dhaka (DMP) and its vendors (Huawei, Hikvision, Dahua).
PRC-built submarine cable participation (e.g. HMN Tech) in Bangladesh landings; SEA-ME-WE 6 supplier not checked.
Interim-government AI policy and any frontier-model or sovereign Bangla LLM adoption beyond exploratory talks.
